risks.title: Inadequate reserves
risks.score_rationale: Reserves for losses and loss adjustment expenses could prove insufficient, which could have a material adverse impact on the company's financial condition and operating results. The report emphasizes that reserves do not represent an exact calculation but rather an estimate of the ultimate cost of settlement, mentioned repeatedly in the Risk Factors section.

risks.title: Market volatility
risks.score_rationale: Volatility in financial markets and economic events could lead to an increase in the number of claims and/or their severity. This directly affects operating results given the company's dependence on financial markets for its investments.

risks.title: Natural catastrophes
risks.score_rationale: Natural catastrophes such as hurricanes, earthquakes and fires constitute a major risk for a property and casualty insurance company. KNSL's E&S portfolio exposes the company to these extreme events.

risks.title: Reinsurance failures
risks.score_rationale: The company may not be able to obtain reinsurance at reasonable prices or with terms that adequately protect its risks. Premium cessions ($361,154 K in 2025) demonstrate the company's dependence on reinsurance for risk management.

risks.title: Climate change
risks.score_rationale: Climate change could have a material adverse impact on the company's operating results due to the expected increase in extreme weather events and natural disasters affecting the insurance sector.

risks.title: Litigation and legal disputes
risks.score_rationale: The company could face litigation and legal disputes related to its insurance activities. The report mentions litigation trends, increases in jury verdicts and third-party litigation financing as factors affecting claims costs.

risks.title: Credit risks
risks.score_rationale: The company could be exposed to credit risks related to its investments in fixed income securities and equities, as well as its operations with reinsurers and brokers. The investment portfolio represents a significant portion of assets.

ai_positioning.summary: KNSL does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F report. There are no explicit references to AI, machine learning or products or services related to AI. The company emphasizes the use of a proprietary technology platform for data analysis and operational optimization, but without reference to artificial intelligence.
